Name: CHR_PHYSICS_VELOCITY_CHANGE_ST
Description: Velocity changes applied to a character by its animation: scales the horizontal and vertical speed, then adds an offset turned by an angle. A row can aim the movement to land on the target.

Fields.Name: Horizontal Velocity Scale
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the character's current horizontal velocity when this change is applied, before Horizontal Velocity Change is added. 1: keep it; 0: drop it. Retail: 0 on most jump rows.

Fields.Name: Vertical Velocity Scale
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the character's current vertical velocity when this change is applied, before Vertical Velocity Change is added. 1: keep it; 0: drop it.

Fields.Name: Horizontal Velocity Change
Fields.Description: Horizontal speed in m/s added in the direction set by Horizontal Velocity Change Direction (after the current velocity is scaled). With Aim at Target, also the speed limit for reaching the target. Retail: 1.8-8 on jumps, 15 on Executor's moving jump.

Fields.Name: Vertical Velocity Change
Fields.Description: Vertical speed in m/s added (positive is up) after the current velocity is scaled. Retail: about 9 on jumps, 21-25 on high jumps.

Fields.Name: Horizontal Velocity Change Direction
Fields.Description: Direction of Horizontal Velocity Change in degrees relative to the character's facing: 0 forward, 180 back, -90 left, 90 right.

Fields.Name: Aim at Target
Fields.Description: 1: when the character has a target position, the jump's horizontal speed is set to reach it, as long as that speed is below Horizontal Velocity Change. 0: normal jump. Retail: set on rows 2, 102, 112 and 10091.

Fields.Name: Unknown
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail 0 on every row.

Fields.Description: FallControlParam row that controls the airborne phase after this change (air drag, gravity and air steering).
